items.headline: 兩位演藝界巨星辭世
items.context: 美國演員露易絲·拉瑟（Louise Lasser）辭世，享壽87歲，她以1970年代邪典喜劇《瑪麗哈特曼，瑪麗哈特曼》(Mary Hartman, Mary Hartman) 走紅，也曾與前夫伍迪·艾倫（Woody Allen）合作多部電影。威爾斯歌手邦妮·泰勒（Bonnie Tyler）也辭世，享壽75歲，代表作《Total Eclipse of the Heart》是1980年代的經典金曲。
items.thread_text:
兩位演藝界巨星辭世

演藝圈這幾天接連傳出消息。美國演員露易絲·拉瑟（Louise Lasser）辭世，享壽87歲，她以1970年代邪典喜劇《瑪麗哈特曼，瑪麗哈特曼》(Mary Hartman, Mary Hartman) 走紅，也曾與前夫伍迪·艾倫（Woody Allen）合作多部電影，晚年還演出過《噩夢輓歌》(Requiem for a Dream)。

威爾斯歌手邦妮·泰勒（Bonnie Tyler）也辭世，享壽75歲。她的代表作《Total Eclipse of the Heart》是1980年代經典金曲，也唱過電影《渾身是勁》(Footloose)的主題曲，還曾代表英國參加歐洲歌唱大賽。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 7 月 9 日及 10 日發佈的報導。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Like tradwifery for children, this revamp of the 19th-century settlers show is a precision-tooled and well-oiled machine. It’s a cosy world full of faith, hope and the American way I never actually watched an episode of Little House on the Prairie, though it bestrode my late 70s-early 80s’ childhood like a ginghamed colossus. This is for the simple reason that Michael Landon’s bouffant hair frightened me. Bouffant hair is such a bad thing. But so great is the power of both the cultural cringe and osmosis that even the most militant Britisher of a certain age has absorbed to some degree the story of the pioneering Ingalls family and its on-screen aesthetic. For the younger folk – it’s tradwifery for children. The series was of course based on the books (and named after the third in the series, which was published in 1935 and hasn’t been out of print since) by Laura Ingalls Wilder. They in turn were an account, shaped for a young readership, of her childhood spent moving across the American West in the 1870s and 80s, settling and resettling in different states as her parents sought their manifest destiny.
